/**
 * Better Auth tables (blueprint "Multi-tenancy": user, session, account, verification, two_factor,
 * passkey, organization, member, invitation, rate_limit). Generated by the Better Auth CLI (`auth` 1.7.22) from
 * better-auth.config.ts; do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @workspace/db
 * auth:generate` whenever the auth config changes, then run `pnpm db:generate`.
 *
 * Ids are uuid so user ids fit the uuid user links elsewhere; the API supplies UUID v7 ids and the
 * column default only applies if an id is ever omitted (ADR 0028, ADR 0029). Better Auth owns
 * these shapes, so they are exempt from the table rules. The organization id is the tenant id
 * (blueprint p13); migration 0001 adds the foreign key from organization.id to tenants.id.
 */
